verdict.rationale: Design-to-code handoff is a fair question for a design tool, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows exports to PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX and MP4, plus OpenAPI-based client SDK generation for Canva's REST APIs. Neither is a component-to-code mapping or shippable design-to-code output, and nothing in the pack documents Canva producing production code from designs.

support.subject: As a developer, designs map to production code — component-to-code mappings or direct design-to-code output I can actually ship
